title: Web Engineering
summary: Fast, secure, search-ready websites and web platforms built on modern frameworks.
description: From marketing sites to full multi-role platforms, we build web products on Next.js, React and Node with performance, accessibility and SEO treated as engineering requirements, not afterthoughts.

services.title: Business Website Development
services.summary: Custom, responsive company websites with a CMS your team can run without a developer.
services.description: We design and build company websites around how buyers actually research and decide. Every site ships with a headless CMS, clean semantic markup, structured data and a performance budget agreed up front.
deliverables: Headless CMS so your team edits everything
Technical SEO foundations and structured data
Analytics, tag manager and form-to-CRM wiring

faqs.q: Can we edit the content ourselves?
faqs.a: Yes. Every page, image and menu is managed from an admin panel, so routine updates never need a developer.

faqs.q: Is the site built for search engines?
faqs.a: Pages are server-rendered with clean URLs, metadata, sitemaps and structured data so search engines can crawl and understand them properly.

services.title: Web Application Development
services.summary: Customer portals, SaaS products and internal tools with secure, role-based access.
services.description: We build web applications that handle real workflows: authentication, roles, dashboards, billing and integrations. Architecture is planned for the load and the team that will maintain it.

faqs.q: Do you build an MVP first?
faqs.a: We usually recommend a focused first release that proves the core workflow, then expand based on real usage.

faqs.q: Who owns the code?
faqs.a: You do. Code, repositories and infrastructure accounts are handed over under your ownership.

services.title: E-commerce Development
services.summary: Online stores and headless commerce with payments, inventory and shipping integrations.
services.description: We build stores that load quickly and convert: catalog and search, checkout, payment gateways, inventory sync and order management, on Shopify, WooCommerce or a custom headless stack.

faqs.q: Shopify, WooCommerce or custom?
faqs.a: We recommend based on catalog size, customisation needs and budget, and explain the trade-offs before you commit.

faqs.q: Can you migrate our existing store?
faqs.a: Yes. We migrate products, customers and orders and set up redirects to protect your existing search visibility.

services.title: API & Backend Development
services.summary: Reliable APIs, integrations and background services that power your products.
services.description: We design clean, documented APIs and backend services, and integrate third-party systems such as payments, ERP, messaging and CRMs so your data flows without manual work.

faqs.q: Can you integrate with our existing software?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with REST, GraphQL, webhooks and file-based integrations, and add adapters where a system has no API.

faqs.q: How is the API documented?
faqs.a: Every API ships with versioned documentation and example requests your team or partners can use immediately.

title: Mobile Apps
summary: Cross-platform mobile apps and installable web apps that feel native.
description: We build mobile experiences for iOS and Android from a single codebase where it makes sense, and installable progressive web apps where an app store listing is not required.

services.title: React Native App Development
services.summary: One codebase, native-feeling apps for iOS and Android.
services.description: We build cross-platform apps with React Native, sharing logic with your web product where possible. Offline support, push notifications and secure authentication are part of the standard build.
deliverables: iOS and Android app from one codebase

faqs.q: Will it feel like a native app?
faqs.a: Yes. We use native navigation and platform components so the app behaves the way users expect on each device.

faqs.q: Do you help with store publishing?
faqs.a: We prepare builds, listings and compliance requirements and guide you through submission to both stores.

services.title: Progressive Web Apps
services.summary: Installable, offline-capable web apps without an app store.
services.description: A progressive web app gives users an installable, fast experience from the browser, with one codebase and instant updates. It is often the quickest route to a mobile-friendly product.
deliverables: Shared codebase with your web product

faqs.q: When is a PWA the right choice?
faqs.a: When you want broad reach, quick updates and lower cost, and do not depend on deep device features or store distribution.

faqs.q: Can it work offline?
faqs.a: Yes. We cache the screens and data that matter and sync changes when the connection returns.

title: AI & Automation
summary: Practical AI assistants and workflow automation that remove repetitive work.
description: We apply AI where it measurably saves time: answering customers, processing documents and connecting the tools your team already uses. Every solution has guardrails and a human in the loop where it matters.

services.title: AI Chatbots & Assistants
services.summary: Assistants trained on your own content to answer customers and support your team.
services.description: We build chat and voice assistants grounded in your documents and data, with clear handover to a human, conversation analytics and controls over what the assistant may say.
deliverables: Assistant grounded in your knowledge base

faqs.q: Will the assistant make things up?
faqs.a: We ground answers in your approved content, restrict the topics it handles and route uncertain questions to a person.

faqs.q: Where does our data go?
faqs.a: We agree the data flow up front, minimise what is sent to model providers and keep sensitive records inside your systems.

services.title: Workflow Automation
services.summary: Connect your tools and automate approvals, notifications and data entry.
services.description: We map manual processes and automate them across your CRM, spreadsheets, email, messaging and internal tools, with logging so you can see what ran and why.

faqs.q: Which processes are worth automating?
faqs.a: Repetitive, rule-based tasks with clear inputs and outputs, such as lead routing, report generation and invoice follow-ups.

faqs.q: What if an automation fails?
faqs.a: Failures are logged and alerted, and critical flows retry safely so nothing is silently lost.

services.title: Document & Data Intelligence
services.summary: Extract, classify and search information across documents and records.
services.description: We build pipelines that read invoices, forms and reports, extract structured data, and make large document sets searchable, with review screens so your team stays in control.

faqs.q: How accurate is extraction?
faqs.a: Accuracy depends on document quality. We measure it on your real samples and add review steps for low-confidence fields.

faqs.q: Can it handle regional languages?
faqs.a: We test on your actual documents and languages before committing to a scope.

title: Business Software
summary: CRM, ERP, POS and operations software tailored to how your business runs.
description: When off-the-shelf tools bend your process out of shape, we build software that fits it: lead and customer management, inventory, billing, scheduling and reporting in one place.

services.title: Custom CRM Development
services.summary: Lead, pipeline and customer management designed around your sales process.
services.description: We build CRMs that match your pipeline stages, roles and reporting, with enquiry capture from your website, follow-up reminders, notes, activity history and dashboards.
deliverables: Lead capture from web, email and WhatsApp
Import from spreadsheets and existing tools

faqs.q: Why build instead of buying a CRM?
faqs.a: A custom CRM makes sense when your process is specific, you need tight integration, or per-seat pricing becomes costly.

faqs.q: Can we import our current leads?
faqs.a: Yes. We import from spreadsheets and other CRMs and clean duplicates during the migration.

services.title: ERP & Inventory Software
services.summary: Stock, purchasing, billing and operations in one system.
services.description: We build operations software covering inventory, purchasing, sales, invoicing and multi-branch reporting, with role-based access and an audit trail for every change.

faqs.q: Can it replace our spreadsheets?
faqs.a: That is the most common starting point. We model your current sheets and workflows and move them into a controlled system.

faqs.q: Does it support GST invoicing?
faqs.a: Invoice formats and tax rules are configured to your requirements and reviewed with your accountant.

services.title: Dashboards & Reporting
services.summary: Live dashboards that turn scattered data into decisions.
services.description: We connect your data sources and build dashboards your managers actually use, with filters, scheduled reports and role-specific views.

faqs.q: Can you use our existing data?
faqs.a: Yes. We connect databases, spreadsheets and APIs and agree metric definitions so the numbers are trusted.

faqs.q: How often does data refresh?
faqs.a: From near real time to daily, depending on the source and what the decision needs.

title: Design & Experience
summary: Research-led UI/UX design and design systems for products people enjoy using.
description: Good software starts with clear flows. We research, prototype and test interfaces before engineering starts, then hand over a design system developers can build from.

services.title: UI/UX Design
services.summary: User flows, wireframes and polished interfaces for web and mobile.
services.description: We map user journeys, test prototypes with real users and deliver interface designs with accessibility and responsiveness built in.

faqs.q: Do you design before building?
faqs.a: Yes. Validating flows in a prototype is far cheaper than changing built software.

faqs.q: Can you redesign an existing product?
faqs.a: We audit the current experience, prioritise the biggest friction points and redesign incrementally or in full.

services.title: Design Systems
services.summary: Reusable components and guidelines for a consistent product.
services.description: We create component libraries and design tokens shared by design and engineering, so new screens are faster to build and stay consistent as the product grows.

faqs.q: Is a design system worth it for a small product?
faqs.a: A light system pays back quickly once more than a few screens or more than one developer is involved.

faqs.q: Do you provide code as well as design?
faqs.a: Yes. Components are delivered as tested React code alongside the Figma library.

title: Cloud & DevOps
summary: Deployment, hosting, security and ongoing support for products that must stay up.
description: We set up and operate the infrastructure behind your software: automated deployments, backups, monitoring and security hardening, plus maintenance plans for after launch.

services.title: Cloud Deployment & DevOps
services.summary: Automated deployments, environments, backups and monitoring.
services.description: We build CI/CD pipelines, staging and production environments, backups and monitoring so releases are routine and recoveries are planned.

faqs.q: Which cloud do you use?
faqs.a: We choose based on your needs and budget, commonly Vercel for web apps and AWS or a managed VPS for backend services.

faqs.q: Can you take over existing hosting?
faqs.a: Yes. We audit what you have, document it and improve reliability and cost without disrupting the live site.

services.title: Maintenance & Support
services.summary: Updates, security patches, fixes and improvements after launch.
services.description: Software needs care after launch. Our support plans cover dependency updates, security patches, monitoring and a fixed number of improvement hours each month.

faqs.q: Do you support software you did not build?
faqs.a: Yes, after a short code and infrastructure review to confirm we can support it well.

faqs.q: What are your response times?
faqs.a: Response targets are agreed per plan and severity, and written into the support agreement.

title: Search & Growth Engineering
summary: Technical SEO, speed and analytics so your product can be found and measured.
description: We handle the technical side of visibility: crawlability, speed, structured data and measurement, so the marketing you invest in has a sound foundation.

services.title: Technical SEO
services.summary: Crawlability, indexing, structured data and site architecture done properly.
services.description: We audit and fix the technical issues that hold sites back: crawl errors, duplicate content, slow templates, weak internal linking and missing structured data.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee rankings?
faqs.a: No one honestly can. We fix what is technically in the way and measure the effect transparently.

faqs.q: How long until we see results?
faqs.a: Technical fixes can show effects in weeks, while competitive rankings usually take several months of consistent work.

services.title: Performance Optimisation
services.summary: Faster pages, better Core Web Vitals and lower bounce.
services.description: We profile real user performance, then fix the heaviest problems: images, scripts, fonts, server response and layout shifts.

faqs.q: What speed target do you aim for?
faqs.a: Good Core Web Vitals on real mobile connections, measured before and after so the gain is visible.

faqs.q: Will optimisation change my design?
faqs.a: Rarely. Most gains come from how assets and code are delivered, not from changing how the site looks.

services.title: Analytics & Tracking Setup
services.summary: Clean measurement with tag manager, analytics and conversion tracking.
services.description: We set up analytics, tag manager and conversion events with consent handling, so you know which channels and pages produce enquiries.
deliverables: Lead source tracking into your CRM

faqs.q: Can we manage tracking ourselves later?
faqs.a: Yes. Tracking IDs and scripts are managed from your admin panel, with documentation for your team.

faqs.q: Is tracking privacy compliant?
faqs.a: We configure consent and data minimisation to match the regulations that apply to your audience.
